name: weekday_successor
description: Name the next weekday; matched control copies the stated current weekday.
generator_code:
import json,random
random.seed(0)
days='Monday Tuesday Wednesday Thursday Friday Saturday Sunday'.split()
items=[];control=[]
for i in range(112):
 d=i%7;person=random.choice(['Ada','Ben','Cara','Dan','Eva','Finn','Grace','Hugo'])
 prefix=f'{person} says today is {days[d]}. '
 items.append({'prompt':prefix+'Tomorrow is', 'answer':' '+days[(d+1)%7]})
 control.append({'prompt':prefix+'Today is', 'answer':' '+days[d]})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
